title: Competitive receptor binding assay to probe for agonist binding to CXCR2
protocol: Cultivate cells expressing CXCR2 in a 24-well plate overnight in DMEM medium plus 10% FCS.
Remove the medium and add binding buffer (medium without FCS).
Place the plate on ice for 10 min.
Add cold agonist (rMIF or cold CXCL8) together with tracer (40 pM of 125I-labeled recombinant CXCL8).
Incubate at 4°C for 90 min to perform equilibrium receptor binding.
Remove the medium and wash cells twice with cold medium.
Harvest cells by adding 0.5 M NaOH.
Transfer cell lysate to a liquid scintillation tube.
Add Aquasafe 500 plus LSC cocktail and mix well.
Determine cell-bound radioactivity by liquid scintillation counting.
Calculate EC50, Ki, and Kd values using the Cheng-Prusoff equation with GraphPad software.
